classification: pre-admission structural audit; no independent arithmetic estimate admitted
source_review_scope: Unchanged sources reconciled against preceding complete review; every registered status/obstruction and continuation demand reassessed; relevant NS74 control read. No historical proof or certificate replay.

proposal.object: For fixed prime p, compare H_N with p H_(pN)[pm,pn] and seek an independently bounded dyadic-index mean of the loss on d_N restricted to p not dividing n, while retaining the other channel and its cross term.
proposal.hypothesis_sought: For fixed p, J^{-1} sum_{j=J}^{2J-1} Delta_(p,2^j)(d_(2^j)^(0)) <= C_p for sufficiently large dyadic J, from arithmetic input independent of the unknown filtered costs. This alone would still not establish a cancellation transfer or bound full K.
proposal.arithmetic_input_beyond_FE: Original fractional-part atoms and mu(pm)=-mu(m) for p not dividing m, mu(pm)=0 otherwise. These data are not all preserved by DH or NS100/101; no new bound on them was found.

control_screen.DH_structural: sampled-pass on explicit finite spectral surrogates; not the actual NB Gram
control_screen.NS74: same H matrices and scaling loss; unproved bounded-cost target not marked passed
control_screen.additional: Exact positive-Gram mask control refutes contraction from PSD alone; no arithmetic realization claimed

proposal.success_condition: Independent quantified error estimate plus accounting for both coefficient channels; no automatic RH consequence.
proposal.failure_condition: Stop if the only available loss bound is by the same unestimated source cost, or if the remaining same-scale channel/cross term is unestimated.
proposal.budget: one bounded admission audit; no larger physical-Gram scan
proposal.disposition: stop/defer research admission: failure condition reached

wall_check.change: Exact prime-scaling channel bookkeeping audited; no independent arithmetic estimate or thaw

outcome.exact_identity: p c^T H_(pN)^[p] c = c^T H_N c - Delta_(p,N)(c), with 0<=Delta<=c^T H_N c

self_review: The norm factor p comes from U_p=sqrt(p) D_p and is retained.
The Schur complement at pN includes all old indices, not just multiples of p.
The p-divisible coefficient channel includes the p-square zero condition.
Both residue channel energies and their signed cross term remain.
A PSD coefficient-mask counterexample is labelled abstract, not an actual NB counterexample.
The DH diagnostic uses a finite positive spectral surrogate; no physical Gram or quadrature accuracy is asserted.
The full arithmetic target was not tested or marked passed on DH.
NS74 preserves the Gram but changes the loads; its cost-only lesson is not a failure of the actual target.
No theorem-level cofinal conclusion is inferred from the finite diagnostic or coefficient checks.
